title: VB-G-RAM-G Act Replaces MGNREGA: Wage Employment Guarantee Increased to 125 Days
summary: Replaces MGNREGA from July 1, 2026 with a minimum statutory wage rate of ₹300 per day.

blocks.content: Replaces MGNREGA from July 1, 2026 with a minimum statutory wage rate of ₹300 per day.

items: Statutory Mandate: Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin) replaces MGNREGA nationwide.
Employment Guarantee: Increases statutory wage employment from 100 days to 125 days per year (total budget ₹1,51,282 crore).
Minimum Wage Rate: Wage rates increased by ~10% on average, ensuring no state has a wage rate below ₹300/day.
Initial Outlay: First 'Mother Sanction' installment of ₹25,863 crore released to states to ensure 15-day wage payments.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: New statutory employment guarantee (125 days, up from 100 days) vs minimum daily wage rate (₹300/day).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Why did the government replace MGNREGA with the VB-G-RAM-G Act in 2026?"
💡 **Model Answer: To raise guaranteed annual rural employment from 100 to 125 days, establish a uniform ₹300/day wage floor, and enforce 15-day automated wage disbursement.**
